originality.rationale: The primary 2023 study concerns numerical-radius norms of weighted shifts and first-edge changes. The closest 2015 and 2022 results already supply exact finite-boundary spectral recurrences and must be credited for the entire finite-L calculation. The present claim is narrowly the simultaneous L->infinity critical-strength asymptotic and strong normalized eigenvector profile, with a closed limiting left-mass fraction; no inspected paper or matching indexed finding stated or directly supplied that limit. An equivalent result in half-line Jacobi weak-coupling/threshold-resonance literature remains a real risk. A 2014 finite-matrix moving-edge result was also identified and specifically credited; its complete full text was inaccessible and remains a risk.
residual_risks: The 2015 finite-prefix characteristic polynomial, when specialized and asymptotically analyzed, generates the finite-depth portion directly; that portion is not claimed new.
An equivalent half-line Jacobi point-interaction or weakly coupled moving-defect continuum limit may be published under non-shift terminology outside the inspected works.
Published published-finding corpus semantic search is not an exhaustive mathematical novelty guarantee.
